evidence_type: Assistant visual transcription of the learner-supplied DBeaver aggregate screenshot; all five rows and twelve fields, including every complete PASS value, are visible. No direct learner-database read.
comparison_scope: All 243920 item/store/week targets across 30490 pairs in eight weeks, 2016-02-27 through 2016-04-22, within the accepted twelve-week input. Each target uses its own pair's four immediately preceding actual weeks. The frozen priority classes SUDDEN_ZERO, LARGE_INCREASE, LARGE_DECREASE and NONE partition the population; TOTAL is displayed last. Zeros and missing-price context remain in scope.
display_normalization: Remove displayed thousands separators and retain JSON integers for counts and observed_units. Restore only omitted trailing zeros: shares to four decimals (100 to 100.0000), baseline/difference sums to two (18576.5 to 18576.50, -18576.5 to -18576.50, 50705 to 50705.00, 105974 to 105974.00, 2155178 to 2155178.00 and 9894 to 9894.00). Means retain six decimals already visible in all rows. Preserve labels, status and row/column order. NULL would remain JSON null; none is displayed. No underlying target classification is recomputed from the screenshot.
fingerprint_method: SHA256 over five ordered report row arrays, each in output_columns order, encoded as UTF-8 compact JSON with ensure_ascii=True, comma/colon separators and one LF after every row. Counts and observed units are JSON integers, shares fixed-four-place strings, baseline/difference sums fixed-two-place strings, means fixed-six-place strings, and class/status values strings. This is the frozen SQL51 report hash protocol, not a hash of the results object list.

displayed_aggregate_controls.flagged_share_computation: 100 * (902 + 6118 + 5327) / 243920, rounded once to four decimals; not a true-anomaly prevalence estimate.

scope: All 60 displayed aggregate values match the frozen preflight after display normalization. Screenshot acceptance establishes agreement of the learner-visible report and displayed aggregate identities, not an independent audit of the learner database, source membership, all 243920 individual classifications or conceptual understanding. Exact classification of 243920 targets across twenty fields, accepted SQL50 feature matching across eighteen fields, all 365880 weekly-input rows across twelve fields, 365864 prices across four fields, 36588 pooled rows across eight fields, the unchanged SQL50 eight-row report, four focused cases, seven unchanged input snapshots/source/dependency preservation, 49 unchanged historical preflights and private-file cleanup remain separate historical assistant preflight evidence. The original preflight retains its historical learner-pending scope; this record supplies subsequent acceptance. The 12347 flagged positions are retrospective rule-based review candidates, approximately 5.0619% of all 243920 targets, not verified anomalies, stockouts, independent events or unique products. A series may enter multiple classes across weeks, so class distinct-series counts cannot be added to obtain a unique flagged-series count. NONE means no frozen rule triggered, not verified normality. Signed baseline differences do not estimate lost demand, lost sales, forecast errors from a new evaluation or financial benefits. Repeated target/history windows overlap, and rule-selected group means do not independently demonstrate detection quality. No human truth labels, true-anomaly prevalence, precision/recall, causal mechanism or realised benefit is established. Original screening rules, accepted forecasting choices and price-association evidence remain unchanged.
